newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil November exports total $3.912 billion.
newsitem.headline: Brazil November exports total $3.912 billion.

text.p: Brazil exported $3.912 billion in November against $4.188 billion in October, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce said.
The Ministry said in a statement that daily average exports in November were $195.6 million against $190.4 million in October.
The Ministry said November's results were 3.36 percent down on the $4.048 billion exported in November 1995.
Exports for the January to November period of 1996 totalled $43.958 billion against $42.631 billion in the same period a year ago.
In October, Brazil posted a record $1.3 billion trade deficit. November's trade balance is expected to be announced around the middle of December.
